description: This file defines the SecondaryCommandBuffer class and related command structures for Vulkan command buffer management within ANGLE's Vulkan renderer. It includes command enums, parameter structs, and methods for recording GPU commands in a lightweight, CPU-side command buffer.

classes.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer
classes.description: A lightweight, CPU-side command buffer class for recording Vulkan commands to be executed on the GPU. Supports various command recording methods, command execution, and diagnostics.
